answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after verified useful work, so spawning thousands of fake identities multiplies the attacker's cost instead of granting free votes. A shared reputation ledger acts as a haven for proven agents, while newcomers start in a shallow lagoon of limited permissions and low-value tasks until their record earns trust. Like a nebula condensing into stars, sparse early signals gradually accumulate into a dense, checkable history that cheap clones cannot fake quickly.
